issues.description: B1 - int_vld_02_01 negative case (tests/integration/validation_vld_unit_test.zig): "s > 0" (string > number) on a bool-expecting gateway guard yields 0 findings, so the expect(findings.len >= 1) + expect(saw_operand_error) assertions fail. Root cause: src/validation/typecheck.zig inferType .cmp_expr branch infers both operand types but NEVER validates operand-type compatibility - it unconditionally returns .bool. Spec tests/specs/vld-01-03-stage-16-validation.spec.md lines 265 and 322 require a finding for string > number (OperandTypeError per line 265 / TypeMismatch per table line 322). This is an IMPLEMENTATION defect in src/validation/typecheck.zig, which TEST-DESIGNER is forbidden from touching (constraint: do NOT modify src/validation/*.zig; R6/R8/R9 are BACKEND-DEV). The failure was MASKED before this rework because the earlier arithmetic-loop assertion aborted the test block first. Fix: BACKEND-DEV adds an operand-compatibility check in the .cmp_expr branch (emit OperandTypeError when operands are not same-typed comparable), satisfying the spec. No test-only change can legitimately make this pass without either removing the negative case (loses coverage) or altering what the test measures (violates core-directives).

B2 - int_vld_03_http_200 (tests/integration/validation_vld_http_test.zig): happy_graph conditions "amount > 0" / "amount <= 0" reference variable `amount`, but handleValidate passes an EMPTY env (Definition has no variable_schemas column yet - VLD-04 will pre-fetch), so `amount` is unknown -> UnknownVariable finding -> HTTP 422, expected 200. Pre-existing test-harness/fixture defect NOT in the validated R10 list. Same classification as R10-3 (all http-layer fixes are test-file-only per design R10). Proposed fix (TEST-DESIGNER, needs scope-expansion validation): drive the happy-path HTTP fixture with literal-only conditions (e.g. "1 > 0" / "1 <= 0") that resolve to 0 findings under the empty handler env, preserving the test intent (clean def -> 200).

B3 - int_vld_03_cross_tenant_404 (tests/integration/validation_vld_http_test.zig): handler invoked as tenant B (random UUID) returns 500 not 404 - [pool] query failed sqlstate=42P01 on the getById SELECT (SELECT id, name, version, ... FROM process_definitions). Root cause: tenant B is not provisioned, so pool.applyRequestStorageRouting resolves storage_mode via resolveAndCacheStorageMode to LEGACY_RLS fallback -> SET search_path TO public -> process_definitions does not exist in public (it lives in tenant_default in SCHEMA mode per migrations 087/1135). The 404 relies on RLS (LEGACY_RLS) or on a provisioned tenant_b schema (SCHEMA). Pre-existing harness defect NOT in the validated R10 list. Proposed fix (needs design confirmation + TEST-RUNNER env): provision tenant B via bpm.provisioning.provisionTenantSchema (as other integration tests do, e.g. idn05_role_registry_test.zig) so its search_path routes to tenant_<b>,public and the empty schema yields DefinitionNotFound -> 404.
